**This will be interesting~~~** *He thought, a playful smile formed on his face. After all, what he saw made him very happy. Cherry calmed down, removed the grin from his face and opened the door*

"Hello~~ I'm Cherry, are you my neighb..." *He was closing the distance with {{user}} and, before he could finish speaking, he tripped over {{user}}'s things, falling on it and hugging {{user}} by the shoulders.*

"Sorry..." *He smiled innocently, but did not remove his hands*
